summary: Iteration-6 validated the two new German-market rules and the analyze_tip() regression fix. (A) NEW GUARD: POST /api/tips returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Tip needs a match date & time — add the kickoff to publish.' when match_time is empty or whitespace-only. Frontend surfaces the exact same message via a sonner error toast, and NO tip is written to the DB (verified via /api/tips/mine count = 0 after the rejected publish). (B) STAKE x ODDS RULE: A live AI analyze of a German bet slip 'Stake 25 EUR, Gesamtquote 35.00, Steuer 5%, Möglicher Gewinn nach Steuer 828.63 EUR' returned potential_return='875.00 EUR' (25 x 35.00) — correctly IGNORING the 828.63 tax-adjusted figure printed on the slip. (C) ANALYZE SHAPE FIX: POST /api/tips/analyze now returns stake, potential_return, legs, is_parlay in every response (previously dropped). Frontend published tip round-trips these: e.g. Bayern vs Dortmund 20/07/2026 20:30 Over 2.5 @ 1.90 stake 10 -> potential_return 19.00, legs=1, is_parlay=false. (D) REGRESSION: text-only + single-tip upload+analyze+publish still work end to end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:527-528 correctly rejects empty/whitespace match_time (uses .strip()). No fix needed.

AI_SYSTEM prompt (server.py lines 268-287) explicitly instructs 'stake MULTIPLIED BY odds' + 'IGNORE any tax, fees or deductions' + 'match_time MUST contain the match DATE and kickoff TIME'. Live Gemini honored all three during E2E test.
analyze_tip() return dict (lines 344-358) now explicitly forwards stake, potential_return, legs, is_parlay — fixing the earlier regression where the frontend received undefined for these fields.
Frontend SubmitTipModal.publish() correctly passes stake/potential_return/legs/is_parlay to POST /api/tips (line 106). apiErr() surfaces backend 400 detail as-is in the error toast — good UX.
Carry-over: server.py is ~1116 lines — still should be split into per-domain routers (auth/tips/credits/notifications/admin) for maintainability. Non-blocking.

TipSaveInput has default match_time="" (line 232). The 400 guard catches this at runtime, but consider tightening to a required Pydantic field (Field(min_length=1)) so the OpenAPI schema also documents it as required. Not a blocker.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 9/9 targeted tests pass (test_new_rules.py). Live AI analyze verified 875 = stake(25) * odds(35.00), ignoring 828.63 tax figure.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — 2/2 E2E scenarios pass: (1) no-date tip rejected with exact toast 'Tip needs a match date & time — add the kickoff to publish.', mine_count=0; (2) with-date tip publishes, success toast 'Your tip is live on the Rate Wall! 🔥' visible, mine_count=1 with legs+stake+potential_return persisted.

rca of the issue: Pre-fix behaviours (all now resolved): (1) analyze_tip() was returning a dict without stake/potential_return/legs/is_parlay keys, so SubmitTipModal.publish() posted 'undefined' for those, wiping parlay legs from the created tip. Fix: server.py analyze_tip return dict was extended to forward all four fields from the LLM JSON (lines 352-355). (2) Tips could be created without a match_time (empty string), producing wall entries with 'Kickoff: —' and confusing users. Fix: server.py create_tip() now raises HTTPException(400, 'Tip needs a match date & time — add the kickoff to publish.') if match_time.strip() is empty (line 527-528). (3) The AI was returning tax-adjusted potential_return (e.g. 828.63 for a slip showing German 5% Wettsteuer on 875) because it copied whatever number appeared under 'Möglicher Gewinn'. Fix: AI_SYSTEM prompt (lines 268-287) was updated with an explicit instruction 'ALWAYS compute it as stake MULTIPLIED BY odds ... IGNORE any tax, fees or deductions shown on the slip'. Reproduction (post-fix): submit slip text 'Einsatz 25, Gesamtquote 35.00, Steuer 5%, Möglicher Gewinn 828.63' -> analyze returns potential_return='875.00 EUR'. Confirmed live.
